description: What changed for a company's strategy today: Antevo's business board for the day, the board behind Strategy Radar. Risks and opportunities for companies from trade, regulation, supply, shipping, energy, demand, currencies, funding, labour, technology, cyber, geopolitics and climate. Each entry carries its theme, exposure tags, impact, likelihood and trend in words, why it matters with a date, what to watch, the event that would make a response right, and two or three possible responses with their reasons. Pass as_of (YYYY-MM-DD) for a past board within the last 400 days. Takes no company details; matching to a company happens in the company's own assistant.
name: get_business_board
title: Business board
